tools.name: agent_me
tools.description: GET /v1/agent/me — balances, key prefix, max price. Pending USDC is not spendable until confirmed. If confirmed is low, call funding_instructions.

tools.name: chat_completions
tools.description: POST /v1/chat/completions (buffered). Pass a live model id from get_models. Returns completion plus cost trace headers.

tools.name: create_key
tools.description: POST /v1/agent/keys — mint another key. Does NOT add USDC credit. Plaintext shown once.

tools.name: funding_instructions
tools.description: How to fund a PZERO account and authenticate MCP. MCP never accepts payment or wallet keys. Fund via Studio x402 top-up or agent HTTP signup/refill, then use Authorization Bearer pzero_…

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: POST /v1/image/generate — intent tool for image generation. Rejects enable_web_search. Returns images plus cost trace.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Intent tool: POST /v1/video/queue (settles then enqueues). Returns queue_id + cost. Confirm before calling — this spends prepaid USDC. Poll with get_generation_status or wait_for_video.

tools.name: get_capacity
tools.description: GET /v1/capacity — routable DIEM and price bands before funding or spend decisions.

tools.name: get_generation_status
tools.description: POST /v1/video/retrieve once — JSON status or delivered MP4.

tools.name: get_models
tools.description: GET /v1/models — resolve a live model id before inference. Optional id retrieves one public row (same object as that id in the list). Do not hardcode model ids.

tools.name: get_request
tools.description: GET /v1/agent/requests/{support_reference} — recover cost/trace for a prior request.

tools.name: list_keys
tools.description: GET /v1/agent/keys — list active API key metadata (never plaintext).

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: DELETE /v1/agent/keys/{id} — irreversible. Do not revoke the key used by this MCP session unless intentional.

tools.name: set_max_price
tools.description: PATCH /v1/agent/max-price — raise/lower ceiling (30-80). Use when tools return no_eligible_supply with cheapest_posted_cents. Does not auto-apply.

tools.name: video_queue
tools.description: POST /v1/video/queue — paid settle+enqueue. Prefer generate_video for agents.

tools.name: video_quote
tools.description: POST /v1/video/quote — no settle, no job. Check clears_now vs price ceiling vs funding before queue.

tools.name: wait_for_video
tools.description: Poll video retrieve until delivered or failed. Backs off on 502.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "funding_instructions" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "generate_video" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Intent tool: POST /v1/video/queue (settles then enqueues). Returns queue_id + cost. Confirm before calling — this spends prepaid USDC. Poll with get_generation_…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_generation_status, video_complete, video_quote, video_retrieve · Private data: funding_instructions, list_keys · Public sink: chat_completions, create_key, generate_image, generate_video, get_generation_status, video_complete, video_queue, video_quote, video_retrieve · Destructive: revoke_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_generation_status, video_complete, video_quote, video_retrieve · Private data: funding_instructions, list_keys · Public sink: chat_completions, create_key, generate_image, generate_video, get_generation_status, video_complete, video_queue, video_quote, video_retrieve · Destructive: revoke_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
